harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 as the cluster’s restricted internal NTP source and node2 to synchronize exclusively from node1. Both nodes retained RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0, passed sequential restart persistence checks, and are healthy and synchronized.
actions_performed: Reused the installed chrony 4.6.1 package; no packages, OS release, or kernel were changed.
Configured node1 to serve NTP only to node2 (10.100.85.11/32), enforced by both chrony and persistent firewalld rules.
Configured node2 with node1 (10.100.85.10) as its sole effective time source; public-pool and DHCP-derived sources were disabled.
Preserved the original configuration on each node as /etc/chrony.conf.pre-internal-time with original ownership and permissions.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities, service recovery, configuration persistence, synchronization, SELinux enforcement, SSH access, and zero failed units.

evidence.summary: Captured RHEL release, kernel, chrony version/configuration, boot IDs, networking, listeners, firewall, checksums, service state, failures, and administrative access.

evidence.requirement: Node1 is the restricted internal time source
evidence.summary: Chrony configuration validates with allow 10.100.85.11/32; UDP/123 is listening; matching runtime and permanent firewalld rules are present; chronyd is active, enabled, and synchronized.

evidence.requirement: Node2 synchronizes only against node1 instead of public servers
evidence.summary: Effective configuration contains only server 10.100.85.10; node2 automatically selected that source, reports NTPSynchronized=yes, and direct NTP queries succeeded before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID d49beed9-... was captured; native reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed to 91621ab0-...; chronyd, listener, firewall restriction, checksum, synchronization, SSH, and node2-to-node1 queries recovered.

Healthy baseline boot ID d9f8550d-... was captured; native reboot was acknowledged; boot ID changed to eaa42f1f-...; node2 automatically reselected node1 and recovered synchronization, configuration integrity, SSH, and clean service state.

evidence.requirement: Operating system, kernel, security controls, and access preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 and chrony 4.6.1; SELinux remains enforcing, firewalld remains running, SSH remains available, and no failed units are present.
